content: tauri-apps/tauri-action builds + uploads to a GitHub Release when tagName (+releaseName) is set. Pass args: '--bundles appimage' to restrict to AppImage. Needs permissions: contents: write. Ubuntu deps: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf. Build on ubuntu-22.04 for glibc/WebKitGTK compatibility.
